_comment: Shared skill tree rules (design/gdd/skill-tree.md 3.1, 3.4, 3.5, 7). Node lists live in data/classes/<id>.json skill_tree (class branch) and data/races/<id>.json skill_tree (race branch + combo). Loaded and validated by logic/skill_tree_data.gd: a wrong tier count, cost, type, exclusive pair, unknown effect type, event, action, target, stat, skill or status is a LOAD ERROR. Numbers are placeholders until tools/balance/class_sim.gd measures them.

branches._comment: Per branch, per tier: gate = points that must already be spent in this branch's EARLIER tiers before a node of the tier can be learned (3.3); count = nodes per tree; type/cost of each node; exclusive = every node of the tier is in a 2-node OR pair (excl).

combo._comment: The combo capstone (3.10): needs this many points spent in the class branch AND the race branch.

_class_reset_gold_per_point: Class branch reset price per refunded point (PO default 2026-11-13, docs/po_defaults.md, OPEN Q1). Race branch reset and the race change reset are free.

vocabulary._comment: Node-only words, added to the race vocabulary of data/races/rules.json (GDD 3.5). An effect uses the race words plus these.
vocabulary._mechanics: A node rule that does not fit the generic words above: the engine implements it by id (logic/skill_tree.gd). Each id is listed here with what it does; an unknown id is a load error. Params are the effect's other fields.

mechanics.bulwark_guard: While a Bulwark taunt is up this card takes damage x damage_taken_mul.
mechanics.war_cry_allies: War Cry's buff reaches every ally inside its radius.
mechanics.momentum: After a heavy that hit min_targets+, the next heavy comes one swing earlier (once).
mechanics.titan_swing: Every heavy is a heavy_arc-degree sweep with radius m.
mechanics.unstoppable: CONTROL_IMMUNE during skill casts and heavies.
mechanics.chain_marked_first: Chain Lightning jumps to marked targets first.
mechanics.pack_hunt: Allies deal damage x marked_damage_mul to targets carrying the Hunter's Mark status.
mechanics.deadeye: Every every_n-th basic shot on a marked target is a forced crit that also pierces.
mechanics.skirmisher: Dodge cooldown x dodge_cd_mul; after a dodge the next skill casts instantly.
mechanics.frost_armor_chill: Melee attackers of a Frost Armor wearer get `stacks` chill.
mechanics.weave_rhythm: Every every_n-th skill cast costs no stamina and deals x damage_mul.
mechanics.elemental_convergence: An enemy with burn + chill + shock takes skill damage x damage_mul; dying like that it explodes (radius, atk_mul).
mechanics.blink_caster: An enemy within trigger_radius: blink distance m away (cooldown_ticks) and leave a free Fire Ring.
mechanics.free_casts_after_ult: After an ultimate the next `casts` skill casts cost no stamina.
mechanics.skill_crit_refresh: A skill crit cuts that skill's cooldown by `seconds`.
mechanics.twin_ultimate: Each ultimate re-casts after delay_ticks at `scale` of its numbers; no gauge, no echo of the echo.
mechanics.mastery_overflow: For `ticks` after an ultimate the passive's numbers are x passive_mul.
mechanics.extend_buffs_on_kill: A kill extends this card's active `statuses` by `ticks`.
mechanics.cleansing_dew: A race heal on an ally below `below` HP also cleanses `statuses`.
mechanics.kin_bond: This card heals itself for `fraction` of the healing it gives to allies.
mechanics.world_tree: Once per wave the first ally down is revived at hp after delay_ticks if this card lives (shares the revived-this-wave flag).
mechanics.warding_sigil: This card's shields last +ticks_add; a broken one applies `status` to enemies within radius.
mechanics.overcharge: Runes may go over_max past max; a discharge spends all and scales its payload by runes/max.
mechanics.resonance: Each discharge gives +runes to every other Runeborn ally.
mechanics.bulwark_haste_on_skill: Each skill cast halves Bulwark's remaining cycle.
mechanics.refresh_shortest_on_heavy: A heavy that hit min_targets+ fully refreshes the shortest skill cooldown (cooldown_ticks).
mechanics.called_target: Marked targets take skill damage x skill_damage_mul from the squad; Called Shot prefers a marked boss.
mechanics.grand_archmage: Every every_n-th skill cast fires twice; the copy is free and deals copy_mul.
mechanics.blood_cyclone: Cleave bonus x (1 + missing HP), cap max_bonus; Ragnarok Whirl +kill_add_ticks per kill (cap cap_ticks).
mechanics.trophy_volley: Each skill kill fires a free atk_mul arrow at the lowest-HP enemy (max per_cast per cast).
mechanics.blood_sorcery: A skill kill heals heal of max HP; skills cast below `below` HP get radius x radius_mul.
mechanics.grove_warden: While Bulwark is up, Warden's Grove heals every ally within radius.
mechanics.bark_and_blade: While Living Bark regen is on, each extra enemy a heavy hits heals the most-hurt ally per_target (cap).
mechanics.moonwell_root: Moonlit Arrow on a marked target also roots for root_ticks.
mechanics.spring_rite: Bloomcaster heal cap becomes heal_cap; its overheal becomes regen for regen_ticks on that ally.
mechanics.runic_bulwark: Each Bulwark pulse gives +1 rune per taunted enemy (max max_runes).
mechanics.shatterglyph: The Runic Edge burst counts as a heavy for Cleave and leaves a status zone (radius, ticks).
mechanics.glyph_arrows: Each Glyph Shot discharge marks every enemy within radius of the target.
mechanics.grand_runeweaver: Skill hits on min_targets+ enemies give a rune; Runeweaver's shields also give `status` for ticks.
